actions.name: Compromise multiple Unitronics Vision Series PLC devices by authenticating to internet-connected devices with default or no passwords
Erase the original ladder logic file on the device and download their own ladder logic file containing no inputs or outputs
Rename the compromised devices to delay device operators from accessing the devices remotely
Set the software version of their ladder logic file to an older version to prevent communication with the PLC using engineering workstation
Disable the upload and download functions of the PLC device and enable password protection for upload settings
Change the default port number for communicating remotely with the PLC device from 20256 to 20257
Upload a splash page with defacement message to the HMI screen to prevent operators from reading normal display information
Display a text file with defacement message on an older device that could not display a graphic image

disabling upload/download functions and enabling password protection depends on compromising the device

uploading a splash page depends on having compromised the device
